v26 - v14.x table-bound VM closure capture

- v14.7 / v14.8 / v14.9 only.
- Fixes layouts where the generated interpreter closure is assigned directly
  into a runtime table slot, e.g. `state[59] = function(...) ... end`, instead
  of first being stored in a plain local.
- The mapper can now use simple local/global/table/property lvalues as closure
  references when installing __PF / __PK capture hooks.
- This prevents the failure mode where the dispatcher is detected but the
  mapper reports zero closure makers, leaving the proto dump incomplete.
- Existing v25 root screening, partial salvage, and probe stripping are kept.
